========================================================================

HOW TO USE
- Size: 1536 x 1024 pixels, horizontal 3:2 (landscape). In Grok pick the landscape / 3:2 aspect.
- Save each image as PNG into  starhaven_places_image/  with the exact file name shown after "Save as".
- Places whose image already exists are left out of this file automatically.

The trains are sleek, streamlined carriages of dark iron, brass and polished wood, drawn by an engine car with a large faceted resonance crystal set in a brass housing at its front, glowing soft blue-white; faint rune-lines along their sides. The rails are dark iron inlaid with thin channels of softly glowing blue runes, with tall brass-and-stone crystal pylons at intervals that hum with stored mana. The magic is restrained and elegant — a soft, steady glow and a faint shimmer under the carriages — not neon ribbons, swirls or lightning. Trains run on the rails, never floating free.
